name: Log Toggle Cell
description: Temporarily enable/disable specific log namespaces during a session for debugging and analysis

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

enabled_namespaces.description: List of log namespaces currently enabled

_discovery.describe: Utility cell for toggling application logging levels and viewing logs in real-time. Provides controls for adjusting log verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR) and filtering log sources. Displays streaming logs with syntax highlighting and search capabilities. Instant log level changes with WebSocket updates. Essential for debugging workflows and monitoring system behavior. No external dependencies, negligible performance impact.
